status_legend.deprecated: tagged Deprecated in API metadata (still works unless noted)
status_legend.superseded: docs say a newer API should be used for new work
status_legend.removed: feature/enum item gone — old code errors or does nothing
status_legend.restricted: exists but game scripts may not write/call it (security/capability)
status_legend.discouraged: official docs recommend the newer system; old one still supported
status_legend.outdated-fact: a number/limit/behaviour models remember that changed
status_legend.pattern: not an API status — an obsolete or unsafe practice

entries.new: task.wait(n) — or better, wait on an event/signal

entries.notes: task.wait resumes on the next Heartbeat after the duration; returns elapsed time.
